# Germany

[global-law](../) / Germany

12 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 5 legislation, subdivisions, 6 case law). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 96% | 31% | 83% |

Federal law is well covered for its current text: germany-law holds 6,147 acts as published on Gesetze im Internet up to 2026-10-28 (about 96% of the roughly 6,400 entries in its index), plus the Grundgesetz with every amendment since 1949, and all three spot checks match. But federal acts other than the Grundgesetz have history only from 2019-06-10, only 5 of 16 Länder are linked, the Federal Social Court (BSG) is missing, and four of the six court repositories stop between 2020 and 2025 while the freshness monitor marks them 'current'.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
